errors.text_span: с етикет от 0% до 100%, като скалата е линейна и показва стойности на всеки 10%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the Y-axis is labeled from 0% to 100% with ticks every 10%. The Y-axis in the figure has no visible labels or tick marks.

The description states that the lowest value is 0%. While the axis baseline is 0, the lowest data value shown on a bar is 0.2%. The phrasing, which contrasts the lowest value with the highest data value (59.5%), incorrectly reports the minimum data point.
The description does not mention the color of the bars (yellow with black outlines), which is a noticeable visual feature.
